sentences.text:
In that view of the matter, the following was considered:
(i) The accident was not due to any aggravated or egregious conduct.
( ii) The victim has received compensation.
(iii) The accused 1& 2 has no previous or subsequent case and a due report from the probationary officer regarding their conduct has already been received.
(iv) The accused 1& 2 has also been facing the case all these years.

4. In view thereof, I find that this is a fit case where the provisions of the Probation of Offenders Act,
1958, can be invoked.

Accordingly, upon the plea of the accused, the A1 is found guilty of the offence under Sections 279 and 304(A) of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and 134(a), 134(b) r/w 187 of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 and A2 is found guilty of the offence under Section 304(A) of Indian Penal Code,
1860.

However, without proceeding to sentence the accused 1 & 2, this Court releases the accused 1&
2 on probation under the Probation of Offenders Act, 1958, on the following conditions:
(a) The accused 1 & 2 shall execute a bond before the learned Magistrate undertaking good conduct for a period of one year, failing which they shall appear before this Court to receive sentence.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 19/01/2026 04:37:26 pm )
(b) It is made clear that, as per Section 12 of the Probation of Offenders Act, 1958, the finding of guilty will not be a disqualification for any purpose.

5. Accordingly, the case in C.C.No.2800100 of 2017 on the file of Judicial Magistate No. VIII,
Coimbatore Taluk, Coimbatore shall stands disposed of and this Suo Motu Transfer Case stands disposed of.
nsl Note to the Trial Court: This order is digitally signed and communicated electronically alone.

The Trial Court shall take note of the order and accordingly classify the case pending before them as allowed / dismissed / disposed of, etc, and while doing so, consider any applications such as disposal of properties, etc., and pass appropriate orders, as may be necessary.
Further, the Court below is directed to dispatch the copy of this order to all concerned.
